title: observability: token/KV cost & latency dashboards, tracing spans, and alert tuning
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Motivation: production incidents in October highlighted gaps in token-level visibility for KV caching and per-token cost accounting. This PR adds enhanced metrics, tracing spans, Grafana dashboards, and tuned alerts to reduce noisy page-ops and improve signal-to-noise for cost/latency regressions. Changes: 1) Instrument token-level KV cache metrics (hit_count, miss_count, kv_latency_ms p95/p99) and expose per-model and per-route labels. 2) Add tracing spans around KV cache lookup and async batch scheduling to make tail latency root-causes visible in traces. 3) New Grafana dashboard reusable panels for token cost breakdown, KV hit-rate heatmaps, per-route token latency distributions, and combined cost/latency SLO panels. 4) Alert tuning: move from static threshold to burn-rate style alert for cost regressions, add sustained tail-latency alert for p99 over 5m with 3/5 occurrences, and suppress alerts for known onboarding models via label-based inhibition. 5) Add migration script to backfill historical test metrics for dashboard onboarding. Testing: unit tests for metrics tagging, integration test that validates metrics emitted during synthetic workloads, manual QA on staging dashboards, and canary rollout with feature flag. Backwards compatibility: metrics names are additive; no breaking rename. Rollout plan: gradual rollout to staging -> canary (10%) -> full cluster with monitoring for alert noise. Followups: add auto-tuning suggestions in Redwood Optimize based on these signals (tracked in ENG-5030).

review_comments: Liam Chen: Left a couple of nits around label cardinality - please ensure model_id is optional and sanitized before attaching. Requested changes.
Aisha Kumar: Addressed the cardinality concerns by adding model_id normalization and a switch to only attach high-cardinality tags when feature flag enabled. Added tests.
María González: Approved after verifying dashboards on staging and confirming alerts reduce noise during warmup.
Ethan Park: Commented on alert thresholds and suggested using burn-rate for cost; I updated rules to use sustained burn-rate check and added inhibition rules for known noisy models.
release_notes: Added token-level KV cache metrics, tracing spans for KV lookups and batching, Grafana dashboard for token cost/latency breakdowns, and tuned Prometheus alerts to reduce noisy pages. No breaking changes.
